rationale: Repair the authoritative-publication and published-evidence boundary so governed conditional semantic ingredients can be represented as explicit immutable key/value attributes with their own evidence references, bound into the publication receipt, persisted losslessly, and projected onto runtime EvidencePackage objects without re-parsing flat claim text. This does not authorize any product publication and does not change reasoning algorithms.
supersession_impact: No capability is superseded. Existing factual publication records remain valid with an empty semantic-attribute tuple; the current publication and evidence capabilities gain a structured semantic path within their existing authority.
authority_impact: No new publication or reasoning authority is granted. The authoritative gate still requires an approved PUBLISH decision and exact governed lineage, while the evidence resolver only carries explicitly published semantic attributes forward and may not infer values from prose.
